review_notes.detail: All 36 card functions and A1 portions, and 72 printed input terminals were compared against enlarged native TIFF bank crops. The literal BQ terminal is B05; BR is B09.
Native footer title, revision, P.N. 2585944, BLK BZ, and every connector-table row in its three columns were checked in enlarged native crops.

Native top-right paper-feed tear preserves 000 and final 01; the three preceding page-identifier cells are too damaged to read confidently and are �. Clear title/footer identifiers and scan neighbors RT581 and RT621 establish the page as RT601.

Independent direct inspection of the original gray TIFF found the first location glyph too worn for a secure B/E reading. AR1B B-C3D4 remains source-legible. Proof: tmp/ald-text/rt/high/prefix_RT601/independent original gray prefix findings.json.

RT601 native paired body borders and roofs confirm seven standard banks at character columns 50, 73, 96, 119, 142, 165, 188. Source raster has local skew and uneven physical bank spacing, so a single global affine pixel map is inadequate for wire verification.
AS5E has a seven-row body; BS5M has an eight-row body. Native crops show AJ/BJ feeding upper inputs and AP/BP lower inputs on separate stems.
Native bank-one crops print AQ B13, AR G05, BQ B05, BR B09. The crossing rails are visually separate where no diamond is printed. AQ B13 continues to the +PADDL 60 output and BR B09 to +SADDL 05.

Full native overview and enlarged bank crops were compared against the JuliaMono preview. The four paired 3-bank rails, six 4-bank control rails, register feedback, reset paths, and right outputs follow the source diamonds and distinct crossings. Horizontal scan-to-grid occupancy check found no missing five-cell source wire runs; local raster warp prevents using a single affine vertical comparison.

Row 1 is torn through the paper-feed band. Native enlarged crop retains TA KE, 0 TO, and trailing 1AE4; unreadable print is represented by � rather than silently completed. The likely intended signal is - DATA KEY 60 TO ST, probably PX201AE4, by paired 61-bit row and neighboring T-register sheets; this completion is an inference, not transcribed literal print. The surviving horizontal traces and right bend into AG D10 support a continuous wire across row 1. Proof: low_52_62/RT601/top-text-enhanced.png and top-right.png. Scan neighbors are recorded in semantic JSON and review notes.
